scope: VCS problem mapping, component selection, and elemental abundance checks

implemented.phase_order: Declared/indexed element order and phase-local electron/charge rows
implemented.vcs_elabcheck: Source-derived bounds and specialized zero/electron/charge tolerances
implemented.basopt_component_selection: Abundance-weighted candidate selection, single-species tie handling, minor-growth candidate selection, modified Gram-Schmidt independence cutoff, and component-first permutation
implemented.problem_preparation: Global species-phase mapping, phase-local to global element columns, formula matrix, starting moles, element goals, standard Gibbs over RT, and component basis

limitations: No exact pinned-native differential probe directly compared the Python selected basis or matrix against internal VCS workspace values.
vcs_basopt stoichiometric coefficient solve and voltage-specific coefficient correction remain unported.
VCS main active-set iteration, species deletion/reinsertion, phase birth/death, and equilibrium convergence remain unimplemented; vcs_solve_TP prepares the problem then explicitly raises.
This evidence validates regression behavior and translated routines, not full VCS parity.
